title: archwiki_rag: offline semantic search over the Arch Wiki
objective: Let Claude answer Arch questions by symptom rather than by page title, with no network round-trip, by indexing the arch-wiki-docs dump that is already on disk and exposing it to the knowledge-rag MCP server.
acceptance_criteria: Converts the local arch-wiki-docs dump into a markdown corpus without fetching pages over the network
Builds a searchable index and refreshes it via `sync --reindex`
install.sh installs its own dependencies, wires the MCP config and registers a pacman hook so the index follows package updates
100% branch coverage across every module in python_pkg/archwiki_rag
The generated index is not committed (machine-specific, binary, regenerable)
out_of_scope: Duplicating yay-mcp's pacman install/remove/update, PKGBUILD checks or system stats — this package only searches
Fetching wiki pages over the network at query time
Replacing the generic wiki-kb pipeline for non-Arch wikis
verifier: python -m pytest python_pkg/archwiki_rag --cov=python_pkg.archwiki_rag (61 passed, 100% branch coverage on cli, constants, convert, reindex, sync, _reindex_entry)
